name: voice-issue
description: Speak a note; it is transcribed locally and drafted into a structured GitHub issue you review before it is created.

whisperModel.title: Whisper model
whisperModel.description: faster-whisper model for local English transcription. Larger is more accurate and slower. One of: tiny.en, base.en, small.en, medium.en, large-v3.

draftModel.title: Drafting model
draftModel.description: Claude model that turns the transcript into an issue. One of: haiku, sonnet, opus.

idleMinutes.title: Keep Whisper loaded (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: How long the transcriber stays in memory after its last use before it exits by itself.
